title: Crisis Management
overview: This course equips participants with practical crisis management strategies and solutions, focusing on the effective implementation of Crisis Command, Control, Communications, and Intelligence (C3i), along with stakeholder management. Designed for those seeking a deeper understanding of crisis management and eager to engage in realistic scenario-based challenges, this course is an invaluable opportunity.
audience: Ideal for professionals working in non-hazardous environments such as corporate offices, retail, transportation, hospitality, healthcare, and public services. This course is tailored for senior managers responsible for managing crises at both strategic and tactical levels.
methodology: he course is highly interactive, incorporating group discussions, video presentations, case studies, and collaborative exercises. Participants will engage in scenario-based crisis management exercises and receive guidance on developing their own crisis management strategies.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Grasp the fundamentals of Crisis Management and the preferred frameworks for both private and public sectors
Understand the escalation process from incident to crisis to disaster
Apply crisis management tools and techniques to effectively navigate organizational pressures
Create a comprehensive stakeholder management plan for crisis situations
Identify actionable measures to enhance their organization's crisis management capabilities
